svg.aria-label: Client request path in the four migration stages. In stage 1 and stage 2 the request goes through the tenant Gateway, Kuadrant and the per-model HTTPRoute to the pods. In stage 2 a Praxis proxy and a forwarding route exist, and only test traffic reaches the proxy. In stage 3 the per-model routes are removed and the forwarding route sends model requests to the Praxis proxy. In stage 4 the Kuadrant policies are removed from the Gateway.
